videos.overview: The discovery of a body at Stony Point, a fisherman's obsession with oil pollution and his claim that fish are dying near the Hastings oil refinery present the Homicide detectives with an intriguing case.

videos.title: Blood
videos.overview: When hamburger shop owner Bill Walker is stabbed to death, his son Michael, with blood on his hands, tells police that an intruder murdered his father, and when he tried to intervene his hand was slashed with the knife.

videos.title: The Experts
videos.overview: A man is killed when the car he is driving explodes and bursts into flames. Homicide is told by Forensic that the explosives used were the work of an expert, and they later question John Turner, an electrician with past convictions.

videos.title: Handle with Care
videos.overview: A young delivery van driver, Greg Lane, is killed when a parcel labelled "Handle With Care" falls at his feet and explodes. The only clues are a few splinters of wood, a piece of jagged metal, and some charred paper. With the help of Det. Bill Williams from Forensic, they are enough to enable the Homicide squad to track down a psychopathic killer.

videos.title: Lover Boy
videos.overview: Playboy Roger Taylor is fascinating to women, but a pathological liar. His many affairs catch up with him when one of his old girlfriends Is killed, and police are anxious to question him about his involvement with her.

videos.title: I Love You Primrose Taylor
videos.overview: An attractive policewoman, Primrose Taylor, assisting the Homicide squad with office work, nearly becomes a murder victim when detectives search for the killer of an air hostess - and all they have to go on is anonymous telephone calls.

videos.title: Maybe She'll Come Tomorrow
videos.overview: Homicide detectives face a baffling case when a murder is committed at a drive-in movie. The butts of two tickets provide them with a clue and a major suspect.

videos.title: The Wife
videos.overview: Investigations by the Homicide squad into the sudden death of Margaret Fleming's husband reveal a family scandal.

videos.title: Everything in the Garden Isn't...
videos.overview: When Bernard Coleman, manager of a pipe factory, is robbed and murdered, the main suspect is Mick Ryan, an ex-criminal employed as a cleaner at the factory.

videos.title: Too Clever by Half
videos.overview: A look through the rear window of their car makes a grisly start to a day for Margaret and Richard Evans when they discover a man's body lying in the gutter. Three possible suspects are questioned by the Homicide squad.

videos.title: The Hex
videos.overview: When the Watson home is broken into, both Helen and her husband Michael are chloroformed. Helen dies, setting off a chain of events which results in another death and a shooting.

videos.title: Motive
videos.overview: John Mason, a wealthy businessman, is brutally bashed to death. Detectives find a lead to his murder with the discovery of two wills - and a great deal of animosity among the relatives.

videos.title: From the Top
videos.overview: Insp. Fox sees two men fighting on a roof top while out dining, one man falls to his death. The other man is arrested and Fox is the main witness at the trial, but the defence's case puts Fox's credibility into question.

videos.title: Mad Dog
videos.overview: Sister Cameron is shocked when a man's body is blatantly dumped in front of her at the hospital. A doctor later tells detectives that he witnessed two men driving away wearing boiler suits.

videos.title: Death Turns On
videos.overview: Tragedy hits a caravan park when John and Elaine Harvey, asleep in their caravan, are asphyxiated by gas. Detectives are confronted with a number of possible suspects, until a surprise turn of events reveals the truth.

videos.title: Widow Maker
videos.overview: Two Fisheries Inspectors disappear near a small coastal town, and one body is found later. His death looks accidental but the local police Sergeant calls in Homicide when he becomes aware of the peculiar attitude shown by the fishermen.

videos.title: Nothing Ever Happens Round Here
videos.overview: Ernie Clarke's wife, mother and daughter are found murdered by an axe in their home, and Ernie is critically injured. Ernie's ex-crim brother is a suspect, but the case's solution hinges on whether Ernie will recover to answer questions.

videos.title: The Hermit
videos.overview: When 20-year-old Cindy Scott is found murdered in the country, the main suspect is a hermit, Dudley Roberts, living in a nearby shack. When he confesses, police doubt his guilt due to questionable details in his statement.

videos.title: A Ticket to the Grave
videos.overview: When a Ballarat bus pulls into the Melbourne terminus, Alfred Dickens' body is found slumped on the back seat. Police are left with two methods of identifying the murderer. His grand-daughter's disappearance complicates the investigation.

videos.title: Grains of Sand
videos.overview: Eight year old Barry Neal is kidnapped, and callous attempts are made to extort money for his return. Sen. Det. Patterson, against his own training and judgement, becomes personally involved in the distress of the parents. The boy is later found murdered, and when Patterson catches up with the killer he nearly drowns him as they fight on the beach. Patterson later resigns from the Homicide squad.

videos.title: The Girl Who Wanted to Go Home
videos.overview: Sen. Det. Delaney, transferred from the Crime Car Squad, finds his first Homicide case a gruelling challenge: investigating the brutal murder of a young woman, Rhonda Edwards, who is found strangled in a park.

videos.title: Why Lenny?
videos.overview: Small time criminal, Lenny Clark, is killed at the scene of a safe breaking, and police find the victim's wife and his friends unconvinced that Lenny had anything to do with the job.

videos.title: The Floater
videos.overview: Am off-duty policeman is brutally attacked when he comes to the assistance of a pay clerk during a daring daytime robbery.

videos.title: The Crisis
videos.overview: A blast from a shotgun greets Carol Connor and Shirley Cross as they leave a kitchen tea party. Detectives are anxious to question a former boyfriend known to have threatened one of the girls. Sen. Det. Delaney voices his unhappiness about the deaths and sorrow he now has contact with - he finds this new aspect of police work pessimistic and gruesome, and considers resigning from the squad.

videos.title: There Are More Things in Heaven and Earth...
videos.overview: Tony Williams meets a violent death when he is killed by a spear gun as he swims with a friend. His death looks accidental, but police suspect foul play, and discover that he was involved in a blackmail racket.

videos.title: Sleeper
videos.overview: A series of brutal attacks on young women becomes a grim case when one of the girls is murdered. Since the method of attack in each case is similar, police believe the same man is responsible - until the attacks continue after they have caught the offender.

videos.title: Cat's Paw
videos.overview: When a wealthy businessman is found murdered, detectives investigate the activities of his girlfriend, his step-brother and an infatuated young man. An eccentric yoga teacher, Loretta Lorne, aids the detectives in their investigations.

videos.title: Shoot to Kill
videos.overview: An armoured car robbery on a country road and the shooting of the criminals involved opens a puzzling case when one of the security guards accuses his partner of deliberately murdering them.

videos.title: Anti-Gravity
videos.overview: The routine investigations into a minor car accident develop into the search for the murderer of a married woman. Police suspect the woman's husband could have been involved. Sgt. Mackay's girlfriend Joy Bower takes a job in Brisbane after refusing his marriage proposal.

videos.title: An Early Morning Dip
videos.overview: Health fanatic Joe Mason's body is found by a friend at the bottom of a public pool after an early morning swim.

videos.title: Time to Kill
videos.overview: Detectives find themselves investigating two crimes instead of one when a young man is found bashed to death in the country.

videos.title: One Against the World
videos.overview: Help comes from an unexpected quarter for a vicious criminal on the run, and the detectives' task is made doubly difficult.

videos.title: Anniversary
videos.overview: Two bystanders see a man shot and fall to the ground. But when detectives arrive there is no sign of a body.

videos.title: Twigs and Twine
videos.overview: The parents of a missing boy enlist the aid of a clairvoyant and bring about an unexpected chain of events.

videos.title: Old Hercules
videos.overview: The wife of a health fanatic disappears and there is strong evidence to suggest that she has been murdered. Intensive investigation brings to light a number of neighbourhood activities.

videos.title: Second Time Lucky
videos.overview: In their search for the killer of a prostitute, detectives meet up with a wealthy businessman, an overbearing landlord and a henpecked husband whose nagging wife sends him into the sleazy world of prostitution.

videos.title: Head Start
videos.overview: The murder of a small time gambler leads the Homicide detectives to the organizers of a two-up game and their unimpressive standover man.

videos.title: Victim of Fear
videos.overview: A young boy is murdered in a public reserve, but police get little assistance from the angered community. Later Suzie Harris is attacked in the park and immediately runs to her boyfriend, but it turns out he has something to hide.

videos.title: One Inch to Murder
videos.overview: William Phillips is a neurotic old man irritated by young people and their lack of respect for older people. Soon he is being deliberately antagonized and this leads to violence.

videos.title: Little Big Girl
videos.overview: A drunken husband and wife are slashed to death by a samurai sword. Two ardent educationalists, a retarded girl, and an odd job man are questioned by detectives.

videos.title: Disengagement
videos.overview: An elderly woman is found in her home shot and left for dead. The shooting takes place within hours of an unregistered pistol being stolen from the office of a suburban accountant.

videos.title: Cost of Success
videos.overview: When a rich widow is bashed to death at her home, the Homicide team meets up with a nosy neighbour, a cheap criminal, a con-man, and a career prostitute.

videos.title: The Street of Fear
videos.overview: On release from prison, Arnold Stone sets out to avenge himself, and the once proud Carlisle family is subjected to a campaign of terror which results in the unexpected truth being revealed.

videos.title: I Couldn't Sleep... I Couldn't Sleep at All
videos.overview: Homicide detectives are called to the scene of a brutal murder and find many clues, but they strongly suspect a frame-up.

videos.title: R.I.P.
videos.overview: A middle aged invalid is discovered dead in her bedroom and Homicide detectives find themselves on the trail of a demented killer. Widow Mrs. Anstey befriends a mild mannered man, Albert Fisher, in a cemetery, who is actually the embittered killer whose motives are complicated by his belief that his actions are mercy killings. Fisher's daughter Marjorie gradually realizes the situation and begins to fear for her own life.

videos.title: Change of Heart
videos.overview: When a man is shot and his daughter kidnapped, investigations lead the Homicide team to people in the fashion industry.

videos.title: The Rape of Lennie Walker
videos.overview: Homicide detectives are involved in a painstaking search for a pervert who molests and murders young girls. It takes eight months to bring a man to trial, but is he the right man, and if so, is he responsible for his actions?

videos.title: Warcry
videos.overview: A Salvation Army person is shot dead during a street meeting, and police suspect the killer may have gotten the wrong man. Patrick Allenby, whom another Salvo was to testify against, is found to be in the clear, until another Salvo is shot.

videos.title: Skeleton Key
videos.overview: A skeleton found in a lonely grave provides the Homicide team with a puzzling case. The only clues are literally "a rag, a bone and a hank of hair".

videos.title: The Herring
videos.overview: When a suburban housewife is shot, the evidence points to her husband. Then the Homicide team find too much evidence.

videos.title: Fool's Gold
videos.overview: A bookmaker returning home from the trots is shot dead. First indications are that the murder motive was robbery.

videos.title: Nightmare
videos.overview: Misfortune strikes the Carter family, and neurotic mother Valerie Carter is suspected of having beaten her daughter Jeanie to death because of a nightmare in witch she sees spiders crawling all over the girl.

videos.title: Black Sheep
videos.overview: It is said there is a black sheep in every family. Detectives uncover an interesting family situation when there is a murder in the building business.

videos.title: Born Loser
videos.overview: A compulsive gambler is murdered and robbed in a secluded factory area. Detectives interview the victim's estranged wife and son, his employees and a bookmaker.

videos.title: A Good Investment
videos.overview: The attractive wife of a business executive is reported missing, and her body is discovered some time later. An abandoned car provides vital clues.

videos.title: They Clear Them Every Thursday
videos.overview: A retired elderly gentleman, who likes a game of chess, returns home one night to find his wife brutally murdered.

videos.title: Shotgun Wedding
videos.overview: Homicide detectives investigate a murder that leads to a dramatic abduction and a shotgun wedding by the killer.

videos.title: Only a Matter of Time
videos.overview: Two schoolboys studying the stars with a telescope in a park on a dark night become part of one of the Homicide squad's most baffling cases.

videos.title: The Pursuit
videos.overview: A young man runs in panic when his girlfriend's father is murdered, and few people believe he is innocent of the crime.

videos.title: I Killed Amanda Clarke
videos.overview: When a young waitress is found dead in her flat, the Homicide detectives face a most unusual case.

videos.title: Yes, That's Sandra
videos.overview: On a deserted beach, an elderly couple discover the body of Mrs. Sandra Martin. This makes for a great deal of work for the Homicide squad, and Sen. Det. Barnes in particular, when they discover that Sandra had many lovers.

videos.title: We'll Both Remember Angie
videos.overview: A letter bomb is put into Joe Maloney's letter box to kill him, but Det. Sgt. Bob Delaney picks up the bomb and takes it and Maloney's 6 year old daughter inside the house. The bomb explodes killing them both.

videos.title: Initiation
videos.overview: A well planned bank robbery linked with a double murder in a country farm house provides a gruelling initiation into the Homicide squad for Sen. Det. Phil Redford.

videos.title: Mother Superior
videos.overview: The discovery of a body leads to a reunion for Inspector Fox.

videos.title: Suddenly They've All Stopped Talking
videos.overview: When a feud ends in murder, Homicide detectives are confronted by a wall of silence. They have an unexpected encounter with a determined woman reporter, Hilda Schultz, who wants to be a professional reporter but lacks the talent.

videos.title: The Last Way Out
videos.overview: Two prison escapees kill a guard and police are involved in a desperate race to apprehend them before they can kill again.

videos.title: Leopold Alexander Hamilton, Esquire
videos.overview: The death of an heiress begins a case with startling developments.

videos.title: A Mother's Love
videos.overview: When small time criminal Johnny Doyle is stabbed to death, his 'big time' brother Bert takes the law into his own hands. Detectives race against time to save the lives of a mother and her teenage daughter.

videos.title: The Other Man
videos.overview: Derek Johnston, a sawmill owner, bullies his family and causes his teenage children to rebel. When the body of their mother is discovered, it appears at first to be a case of suicide, but a very unusual piece of evidence points to murder.

videos.title: Assassin
videos.overview: Mackay is promoted to Inspector and preparing for a transfer to Ballarat when a threat is made against his life. Carl Warren Lee, who made the threat, is a psychopath who lies in wait with a rifle, but shoots dead Fox by mistake.

videos.title: The Kooranda Killing
videos.overview: Insp. Lawson is recalled from London to head the Homicide squad. Barnes is promoted to Det. Sgt. and Sen. Det. Pat Kelly joins the squad. The first case for the new team is a killing in a small country town that reveals an unusual motive.

videos.title: The Friendly Fellow
videos.overview: The moving story of retired safe cracker Buddy Rand, who, although having gone straight, finds himself breaking the law to help a mate.

videos.title: April Fool
videos.overview: When an early morning payroll robbery leads to murder, detectives find they have a difficult job on their hands. A window cleaner casts new light on the case by giving police a valuable lead which changes the theme of their investigations.

videos.title: Squealer
videos.overview: Both the Homicide detectives and some criminals want a man to tell what he knows about a $100,000 opal robbery.

videos.title: Flight 484
videos.overview: The shooting of a man at Spencer Street railway station seems a simple case, but becomes more involved as inquiries continue, and leads to a powerful man who takes a carefully calculated risk - and loses everything.

videos.title: Matchmaker
videos.overview: Following the discovery of a body in a lake, detectives investigate a computerised dating service. Policewoman Helen Murray risks her life by acting as a decoy.

videos.title: Thommo
videos.overview: Four ex-national servicemen meet for a birthday reunion which ends in disaster when unpleasant memories of an incident in Vietnam are rekindled.

videos.title: To Tell You the Truth
videos.overview: An irresponsible young man, Vincent Mason, is an only child of wealthy parents. Mason has a charm all of his own, but he is also a fanciful liar and his many and varied stories cause a lot of trouble for the Homicide detectives.

videos.title: They Frighten Even Me
videos.overview: A burglar discovers a dead body in a house, and investigations lead to a bizarre couple and the solution to several unsolved murders.

videos.title: Follow the Leader
videos.overview: A drug company truck driver is murdered on a lonely stretch of road. More lives are at stake as the police follow a trail of double-crosses which lead to a boat, the head of an organised hijack gang, a major drug runner and a cache of stolen drugs, culminating in one double-cross that surprises even the Homicide squad.

videos.title: Patterns and Stripes Don't Mix
videos.overview: June Higgins nags her husband and lover to distraction, and is run down. A witness describes the driver with strange results. The case is a trial for Det. Kelly, who is involved in a long chase, car crash and reprimand from Insp. Lawson.

videos.title: One Too Many
videos.overview: A 21st birthday party with a tragic ending has a profound effect on a number of people - including Det. Sgt Barnes, who resigns after "cracking" under pressure.

videos.title: El Dorado
videos.overview: New member of the Homicide squad, Det. Sgt. Harry White, has his hands full when two young boys abscond from an orphanage and set off to seek their fortune.

videos.title: The Jackson File
videos.overview: George Jackson has just served 15 years for murder, a crime he always claimed he did not commit. Unexpected parole for him means much more than adjusting to the outside world - he is determined to prove his innocence regardless of the cost, which spells trouble for his family, friends and the Homicide squad.

videos.title: Mad Dog Kelly
videos.overview: An incident in the cells of the city watch-house leads to an inquiry which threatens the career of Sen. Det. Kelly.

videos.title: The Adventure
videos.overview: A break from routine can be very refreshing, but Alex gets more than he bargained for.

videos.title: The Crossing
videos.overview: Homicide detectives have to cope with a group of unruly girls at a mission following an apparently unmotivated bashing.

videos.title: Jingles
videos.overview: Detectives investigate the murder of a roustabout at a once prosperous travelling carnival.

videos.title: A Crime Against Nature
videos.overview: Homicide detectives come up against some startling attitudes when a homosexual is bashed and killed. The victim's lover becomes a suspect when they find incriminating letters written to the dead man.

videos.title: A Thing of the Past
videos.overview: A suburban policeman comes into conflict with the Homicide squad when he conducts his own investigation of a murder.

videos.title: Just Good Friends
videos.overview: The dramatic death of an American business tycoon takes the Homicide squad to a luxurious penthouse suite and presents a problem for Sen. Det. Phil Redford.

videos.title: Cowboy Billy Day
videos.overview: When Billy Day and his pregnant wife Daphne visit Melbourne to exhibit their prize bull at the Royal Agricultural Show, they accidentally become involved with some bank robbers.

videos.title: Jill the Ripper
videos.overview: A sudden spate of vicious attacks on lone women has the Homicide squad working round the clock.

videos.title: Otto
videos.overview: Homicide detectives are baffled by the discovery of two bodies in the snow at the Mount Buller ski resort.

videos.title: As Simple as A.B.Z.
videos.overview: A strip club murder involving several eminent businessmen spells trouble for private investigator Michael Ryan.

videos.title: Bill
videos.overview: Some nasty remarks about Australian Rules football lead to what police believe is a nasty but simple bashing.

videos.title: Shut Your Mouth and You'll Catch No Flies
videos.overview: A killer avoids arrest by terrorising people with evidence against him.

videos.title: Running Jack
videos.overview: The investigation of a seaman's death provides Senior Detective Redford with a novel experience.

videos.title: Angel
videos.overview: Angel Brewer, believed to be a simple country girl who moved to the city to be a model, is found dead in the bay. The case involves an investigation into prostitution, and shatters a father's illusions about his daughter.

videos.title: Twelve Bar Blues
videos.overview: A former jazz trumpeter, now a derelict, overhears a plot to blow up a boat and its owner.

videos.title: I Keep Going Back to Be Certain
videos.overview: Homicide detectives find there is more than meets the eye when three youths rape a young girl who claims one of them tried to kill her. Investigations get complex when one of the youths is missing, and police suspect his father killed him.

videos.title: Time and Tide
videos.overview: Insp. Lawson visits Sydney for a conference and becomes involved in a murder investigation when the local police find a body floating in the harbour. Lawson comes into conflict with Sgt. Jack Beck on the use of firearms in crime prevention.

videos.title: Penelope
videos.overview: A drunken assault and the disappearance of two young girls leads to tragedy.

videos.title: An Axe for Tommy
videos.overview: While investigating the murder of a petty criminal, the Homicide Squad faces opposition from his young son, who blatantly accuses his mother of the crime.

videos.title: Final Sunday
videos.overview: In an endeavour to better his life and provide for his wife, a factory worker is forced to resort to violence and crime.

videos.title: The Artful Dodger
videos.overview: The husband of a nagging woman sees his opportunity to get some money and escape.

videos.title: Welcome to Mayfield
videos.overview: A wall of silence meets Homicide detectives when they arrive in the little township of Mayfield to investigate the brutal murder of a truck driver.

videos.title: You've Got to Do Something
videos.overview: A drug pusher is murdered at a beach house party. The Homicide squad find their investigations are hampered by three bikies, a father whose loyalty is tested, and a step-son who has something to hide.

videos.title: The Shooting of Jimmy Lines
videos.overview: Homicide detectives investigate a case of mistaken identity when a man is murdered whose name is similar to that of the intended victim.

videos.title: No Rhyme or Reason
videos.overview: When Snr. Const. Alan Reed is shot and blinded for life, the task faced by the Homicide squad when they move into a small country town to apprehend the man responsible is not an easy one.

videos.title: Yesterday's News
videos.overview: Clarrie Lucas is a hard-bitten reporter who has seen it all. When his newspaper journalist mate Len Condon is shot dead, he attempts to solve the crime on his own.

videos.title: Slow Fuse
videos.overview: Racial fights erupt when a wealthy Italian is killed in a blast.

videos.title: Tom Mitchell's Money Box
videos.overview: Investigations take the Homicide squad to Tasmania after a milk bar proprietor and his wife are robbed and murdered.

videos.title: You Hear About The Slasher
videos.overview: A psychopath who kills derelicts is at large and detectives are hard pressed in their endeavour to capture him.

videos.title: The Chaff Bandits
videos.overview: The Homicide squad are called behind the scenes of horse racing when they become involved in the investigation of the murder of a stable hand.

videos.title: The Transhipment
videos.overview: A visiting American policeman and a junkie murdered in Canberra suddenly tie in, and the Homicide squad find themselves on a trail that crosses state boundaries in search not only of a murderer, but also an international drug ring.

videos.title: Brotherhood of Man
videos.overview: When a cripple at a sheltered workshop is murdered, detectives discover a connection between the dead man and a recent art robbery.

videos.title: Stand in for Terror
videos.overview: Homicide detectives are confronted with a difficult case when a homicidal maniac escapes from a prison farm and heads for Melbourne in search of a former girlfriend.

videos.title: The Fellas Send Their Regards
videos.overview: Things become complicated when a Homicide detective finds himself personally involved in a murder investigation.

videos.title: The Fireworks Man
videos.overview: Kenny Sutton murders his wife, steals some explosives and takes a hostage as he heads towards the city to stage his own fireworks display at the Moomba Festival.

videos.title: The Graduation of Tony Walker
videos.overview: An examination of some of the factors which contribute to one of the most serious forms of violent crime - unmotivated bashings. Tony Walker is bored, frustrated and, like thousands of other Australian youths, destined for trouble.

videos.title: Moon Shadow
videos.overview: When two young people are murdered, an old eccentric gives the Homicide squad a hard time and confuses their case.

videos.title: Coup De Grace
videos.overview: Could this be Inspector Lawson's first unsolved murder? The squad seem to think so when a much-liked elderly member of the community is murdered.

videos.title: The Last Season
videos.overview: While investigating a shooting at a large sheep station. Sen. Det. Deegan befriends young Kenny, son of Ross Bullen, owner of the station. The peace is shattered when Barry Lewis arrives to make life unpleasant for Prue Fletcher.

videos.title: Running Nowhere
videos.overview: A British couple who were successful diamond robbers are discovered living in Australia after the murder of their friend. There is a race to find them between the underworld and the police.

videos.title: Mr. Spence
videos.overview: A harmless public servant with a problem, or a scheming killer? The Homicide detectives investigating a case have a decision to make to avert a tragedy.

videos.title: Poker Face
videos.overview: An innocent birdwatcher leads the Homicide squad into the discovery of an illegal gaming house.

videos.title: The Animal That Has To Be Fed
videos.overview: While chasing a truant schoolboy, a young policewoman comes across a torture chamber, and a case for the Homicide squad.

videos.title: Snails for Dinner
videos.overview: Is Patrick O'Brien as respectable as he seems or are the threats to his life coming from someone who knows better?

videos.title: Just Like Anyone Else
videos.overview: Because of the murder of a friend following a brutal attack, a young constable, a friend of Det. Deegan, is forced to choose between his marriage and his career.

videos.title: Soldiering On
videos.overview: A war veteran misses the Anzac Day march, and the Homicide team take his behaviour into account when investigating the murder of a young man who is a confirmed pacifist.

videos.title: The Hooker
videos.overview: When a callgirl is murdered, the Homicide squad enters the exciting world of boxing to investigate the case.

videos.title: Surprising What People Can Do
videos.overview: Is a petty criminal as innocent as his wife maintains, or is he responsible for a brutal murder?

videos.title: Brick Veneer
videos.overview: Homicide detectives discover more than gracious living behind the plush façade of a suburban estate. In the wealthy eastern suburbs a dentist is found dead on his sitting room floor and his wife and 14-year old son are missing.

videos.title: A Nameless Grave
videos.overview: A confession from a dying woman, a pearl brooch and a bitter young criminal lead the Homicide Squad to a grisly discovery within the walls of Pentridge.

videos.title: Thou Shalt Not Want
videos.overview: A young man goes beserk with a shotgun and leads the Homicide squad into the mysterious world of an unorthodox religious sect.

videos.title: The Quiet Ones
videos.overview: A car crashed on a lonely road, but the Homicide squad have doubts that it was an accident.

videos.title: The Last Bastion
videos.overview: A quiet elderly couple reluctantly become involved as witnesses in a brutal murder case, and withhold information from the police.

videos.title: Do Us All a Favour
videos.overview: A brother and sister are gunned down hours before they are due to fly out of Melbourne. A key, a missing fur coat, a NSW payroll robbery and two brothers in the second-hand business are central to the investigation.

videos.title: Speaking Ill of the Dead
videos.overview: The death of a prominent member of the community sets a puzzle for the Homicide squad.

videos.title: Bomb
videos.overview: When a spate of bombings occur, Homicide detectives face a potentially disastrous situation. But when another bomb is found and defused, the contents provide them with a vital clue.

videos.title: Pointing to the Moon
videos.overview: A brutal killer and master of martial arts is on the loose, and the Homicide squad must get to him before more people get harmed.

videos.title: Don't Call Me Steve
videos.overview: When a solicitor is murdered, a schoolboy leads the Homicide detectives to a deserted cinema and a strange friendship.

videos.title: Part of the Furniture
videos.overview: The wife of a leading gangster is shot, and reprisals risk developing into a gangland war. Was it calculated murder, or was the bullet meant for someone else?

videos.title: The Egotist
videos.overview: A series of brutal attacks on women has the squad asking an urgent question: What makes a rapist tick?

videos.title: Starring Joan Kendall
videos.overview: The Homicide squad are confronted by an agonising puzzle when a TV actress stabs her husband to death.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: Random bashing or calculated murder? When a young writer comes under the scrutiny of the Homicide squad, the results are explosive.

videos.title: Long Weekend
videos.overview: Youngsters learn that no one loses friends quicker than criminals on the run.

videos.title: You Probably Won't Believe This, But...
videos.overview: The Homicide squad has found clues to a murder, but they can't find a body. After a bizarre search involving several tall stories and wild goose chases, Insp. Lawson is decidedly confused, and has no case.

videos.title: The Life and Times of Tina Kennedy
videos.overview: Tina Kelly, daughter of Betty Kennedy, a pregnant, harassed, aggressive and downtrodden mother, is found to be dead on arrival at hospital, and the explanation for her fatal injuries do not satisfy the doctor.

videos.title: Formula Five
videos.overview: A racing driver is killed while testing a new fuel injection device.

videos.title: Rampage
videos.overview: Three brutal murders and a one-sided love affair combine to present an intriguing case for the Homicide squad.

videos.title: A Quiet Place
videos.overview: Julie Edwards and her husband Grant are known as a happy, loving couple. But when Julie is shot while sketching in a cemetery, detectives uncover facts which make them doubt this description.

videos.title: Hear No Evil
videos.overview: Is a prominent member of a City Council a straight forward honest man, or is he the instigator of a brutal murder and a savage bashing?

videos.title: Charlie
videos.overview: A burglary occurs at the same time as the death of a very sick woman.

videos.title: A Room for Improvement
videos.overview: A policeman is killed at a factory break-in, and Homicide detectives uncover a long running feud between an ex-criminal and a police sergeant.

videos.title: Short Cut
videos.overview: Figure skater Heather Morton is strangled on deserted land near an ice skating rink. Detectives learn that Heather had loved and discarded many boyfriends, and many of these men hated her.

videos.title: Gladstone Home For Wayward Girls
videos.overview: A few quiet days in the country turn into a nightmare for Danny Simmons when his aunt's maid is found poisoned outside his door. Soon, a similar attempt is made on his own life.

videos.title: Dog Eat Dog
videos.overview: What was going to be just a robbery turns out being a lot more trouble than Sam Horton expected.

videos.title: Don't Be Lonely
videos.overview: The Homicide detectives find themselves involved with a dating service when a body is found in scrubland.

videos.title: When the Cat's Away
videos.overview: When a butcher's wife is found brutally stabbed to death her husband becomes the prime suspect.

videos.title: Free Enterprise
videos.overview: When residents take action to stop redevelopment of their street, one of them is bashed so badly that she loses her baby. The father feels this is reason enough to take the law into his own hands.

videos.title: Why All the Fuss
videos.overview: The squad investigates the eerie death of a homosexual.

videos.title: Third Generation
videos.overview: A criminal comes to Melbourne to settle an old score, but is murdered in the process. His son then turns to crime to seek revenge.

videos.title: Wipe-Out
videos.overview: A farmer is killed by a hitch-hiker, and police suspect an itinerant surfer. Homicide detectives have a difficult task searching for the killer along Victoria's surfing coastline with its many communities and remote beaches.

videos.title: The Start of Something
videos.overview: A woman is murdered in the park. The squad are soon involved in a race to find the attacker, the victim's identity and the motive.

videos.title: Rattles
videos.overview: A dishonest second-hand car dealer is run down late at night, and he thinks someone is trying to kill him. Prime suspects include a dissatisfied customer and his wife's lover.

videos.title: Command Performance
videos.overview: A talented young pianist and his mother stumble across the grisly remains of a vague acquaintance while out walking their dog.

videos.title: Who Saw Them Die?
videos.overview: The Seven National News crew discover two bodies in the Maribyrnong River while doing a story on pollution.

videos.title: I Had a Dream
videos.overview: Melbourne police find the body of a drug addict and proper identification reveals him to be an ex-student leader wanted for a bombing in 1968.

videos.title: Out of Step
videos.overview: A local ballet company is thrown into confusion when its leading dancer is shot after a party held for the press to announce the opening of a new show.

videos.title: Spools and Clocks
videos.overview: An elderly cinema projectionist witnesses the killing of a man on a parking station. He is only too willing to help the police in their investigation, which results in tragedy for him.

videos.title: The Sniper
videos.overview: A young man with a passion for motor cycles shoots his girlfriend and her parents when the girl's father objects to their relationship.

videos.title: I Thought I Could've Died
videos.overview: The owner of a theatre restaurant teams up with an old friend to get quick money for his ailing business, but murder interferes with their well-laid plans.

videos.title: Party Games
videos.overview: The Homicide squad are baffled when a girl commits a murder and then gives herself up.

videos.title: Sanguma
videos.overview: The Homicide squad are baffled when what appears to be suicide turns out to have been caused by a unique form of murder weapon.

videos.title: Outside Chance
videos.overview: During a game of cards, a man is shot dead and the other three players claim it was an accident. Sen. Det. Redford works in his own time to find evidence that he was murdered.

videos.title: Poppet
videos.overview: Homicide detectives are puzzled when a man confesses to the murder of his wife after the coroner has already passed a verdict of death by misadventure.

videos.title: The Whole of the Law
videos.overview: Murder on a lonely country road leads police to suspect that devil worship is involved.

videos.title: Wrong End of the Gun
videos.overview: When two gunmen terrorise migrant shopowners, Detective Deegan faces suspension for assault.

videos.title: Double Take
videos.overview: An armed robbery develops into murder when one of the two bandits panic, leading police on a trail of violence as they desperately try to escape.

videos.title: House to House
videos.overview: Police start a frantic search when a girl is brutally attacked and another is found murdered in a girl's hostel.

videos.title: Antique Murder
videos.overview: An antique dealer is found murdered and the Homicide squad believe robbery was the motive until they discover threatening letters.

videos.title: 8M.M.
videos.overview: Processed film from a home movie camera provides the only clue when a young girl is murdered after touring Victoria.

videos.title: The Graveyard Shift
videos.overview: In the early hours of the morning a body is found draped over a wall in a park, and police suspect the motive was revenge.

videos.title: Two Days at Echo Gorge
videos.overview: A prison escapee murders a prison officer then takes three hostages - or are they hostages?

videos.title: Home After Dark
videos.overview: The Homicide squad investigate abortionists in Melbourne.

videos.title: Stopover
videos.overview: Denny Connell, a member of Gordon Haynes' pop group, dies of a massive heroin overdose on arrival at Melbourne's Tullamarine Airport. Haynes is a 30-year-old pop star whose career has been a succession of hits and crashes. He has been written off many times but has come back - only to crash again. As the investigation progresses, it becomes clear that Connell was murdered, and many motives and suspects emerge. Inspector Lawson goes to London to investigate further, where he liases with Inspector Scofield of Scotland Yard. A few twists are in store before the Homicide squad finally unravel the solution.

videos.title: Leader of the Pack
videos.overview: Luke, the fanatical leader of a religious cult, kidnaps Kim Clayton, daughter of a newspaper magnate, after her 18th birthday party. The Homicide squad's investigations are hampered when her father pays the $100,000 ransom.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: Two dangerous prison escapees take a young woman hostage and head for rugged mountain country.

videos.title: Bunny
videos.overview: An ex-prostitute whose husband is involved in counterfeiting finds herself caught in the middle when her friend is murdered by her husband, and she turns to Detective Redford for help.

videos.title: Daddy's Gone A-Hunting
videos.overview: When a wealthy businessman opens an office door, he triggers a booby trap and is killed in the explosions.

videos.title: Shark Pack
videos.overview: Three bikies force a young motorist over the edge of a quarry to his death.

videos.title: The Accident
videos.overview: A murder victim was aware of the identity of his attacker, and there are no signs of a struggle. Det. Sgt. White faces death when the killer takes him hostage.

videos.title: Gone Fishing
videos.overview: A teenage couple's quiet picnic in the country ends in murder.

videos.title: The Last Task
videos.overview: For the final case, a former member of the squad, now an Inspector, returns to help in the investigation of a massage parlour murder.
